discovery: Development of optical lattice atomic clocks enabling timekeeping at the 10^-18 level
rationale: Recent physics prizes went to quantum circuits (2025), machine learning (2024) and attosecond physics (2023), so precision measurement in atomic, molecular and optical physics is a natural next pick. Optical lattice clocks are a mature, transformative advance: they are driving the redefinition of the SI second and enable tests of relativity and geodesy. Katori proposed and demonstrated the magic-wavelength lattice clock, and Ye pushed it to record precision. Both are perennial top candidates.
